archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Command Center / Trading Terminal)

typography.rules: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use JetBrains Mono or similar monospaced fonts for all tickers, prices, percentages, and countdowns to ensure tabular alignment. Headings should be tight (tracking-tight), and uppercase overlines (tracking-[0.2em]) should be used for labels like 'STOP LOSS' or 'ENTRY'.

colors.rules: Pure #000000 or close variants for background. NO full-screen gradients. Data drives color: only use Green/Red for market direction. Do NOT use teal or purple. Text contrast must be APCA compliant.

layout_spacing.grid_mode: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and compact. p-4 to p-6 inside cards. Gap strategy: gap-4 or gap-6 for tight correlation of data.
layout_spacing.borders_and_surfaces: Cardless or sharp rectangular cards. 1px solid border (#27272A). Max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm) to keep a technical, precise feel. No soft shadows. Use 'Grid Borders' strategy for data tables.
layout_spacing.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to match neighbors. Optical alignment over geometric alignment.

components_instructions.scan_button: The central focal point. Massive CTA (e.g., text-2xl, py-6). Use 'The Tracing Beam' surface strategy (Aceternity style) or a high-tech glowing border to invite interaction.
components_instructions.filters_panel: Dense, top or side panel. Use Shadcn Select and Inputs customized with square edges and high-contrast focus states (focus:ring-primary).
components_instructions.signal_card: Hero widget. Highlight LONG (Volt Green) or SHORT (Electric Red) with bold badges. Massive typography for Entry Price. Clear visual grid for Stop Loss, Take Profit, and Leverage. Include a monospaced countdown for 'hora exata de entrada'.
components_instructions.technical_justification: Text block with low-contrast background (e.g., bg-white/5) and text-secondary, looking like a raw system log or terminal output.
components_instructions.charts: MUST use 'lightweight-charts' for real-time candlestick rendering. Configure chart background to 'transparent' to blend with surface (#141414), grid lines to #27272A, and candlestick colors to match accent_long/accent_short.
components_instructions.history_list: Dense table or narrow list view. Use Grid Borders (border-b border-border/40).
components_instructions.ticker_marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. 'The Editorial Ribbon' / Data Stream style. Placed at the very top or bottom. Deep black background, monospaced text, neon green/red highlights for percentages. Slow, smooth drift.
components_instructions.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for interface. Use react-icons/si (SiBinance, SiBytedance for Bybit) for exchange logos.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp. Background brightens slightly, borders illuminate (border-white/20). Explicitly set hover:text-white.
motion_and_interactions.scanning_animation: When 'Varrer Mercado' is active, implement a 'Retro-Futurism' scanning effect: fast-shuffling ASCII characters or a glowing radar/progress line before the signal locks in.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast focus rings on all inputs.

media_urls.description: Abstract dark tech texture. Use as a fixed background with very low opacity (10-15%) or blend-mode over the deep obsidian base to kill digital flatness.
Use as a muted, dark background for the 'Awaiting Scan' empty state area inside the Signal Card. Overlay with heavy black/80.

testing_instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Applies to buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, user balances, confirmation text, scan button, signal card values. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.
